---
title: "Meetup_data"
author: "Radhika Patel"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r import}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
url <- "https://www.meetup.com/find/?keywords=art&location=us--nj--New+Brunswick&source=EVENTS"
page <- read_html(url)
```

```{r date w/time}
dates <- 
  page %>%
    html_nodes("time") %>%
    html_text(trim = TRUE)

head(dates)
```

```{r group/location}
groups <- 
  page %>%
    html_nodes(".text--labelSecondary a") %>%
    html_text(trim = TRUE)

locations <- 
  page %>%
    html_nodes(".venueDisplay-venue-address") %>%
    html_text(trim = TRUE)

head(groups)
head(locations)
```

```{r}
titles <- 
  page %>%
    html_nodes("h3") %>%
    html_text(trim = TRUE)

length(titles)
length(dates)
length(groups)
length(locations)

cat("Titles:", length(titles), " Groups:", length(groups),
    " Locations:", length(locations), " Dates:", length(dates), "\n")

min_len <- min(length(titles), length(groups), length(locations), length(dates))
if (min_len == 0) {
  print("1 or more fields returned 0 results")
}

titles <- titles[1:min_len]
groups <- groups[1:min_len]
locations <- locations[1:min_len]
dates <- dates[1:min_len]

meetups <- data.frame(
  title = titles,
  date = dates,
  group = groups,
  location = locations,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
print(meetups)
```
